title: Smart2Raw: auto-adaptive integer numeric storage (header-only, C)
description: A header-only C library that stores integer arrays in the smallest native class that fits the real range (±8/16/32/64 bits) and operates directly on the compact format. Includes SIMD-dispatched aggregations AND predicates with runtime dispatch (AVX2 and AVX-512 on x86, NEON on ARM; experimental RVV and SVE2), block-wise width (PFOR) signed and unsigned with frame of reference and zone statistics, zero-copy mmap, portable serialization with CRC32 and analytics. Ships with a whitepaper, a test suite (31 suites, 0 failures) and reproducible benchmarks.
